answer: Gate identity creation behind strict per-source rate limits and the sybil fable collapses: an attacker cannot harbor a thousand fresh accounts from one origin in a burst without hitting the ridge of a throttle. Pair that with a per-epoch minimum-activity rule, so every fake must be continuously fed real work to stay eligible. Honest newcomers trickle in and earn; bulk minting stalls at the gate, because the throughput ceiling is identical for everyone.
